description: Free. Returns the exact EIP-191 message to sign with the payer wallet to spend prepaid credit on a top-up (no x402 payment). Then POST /v1/gas {credit:{message,signature}}. Credit: start with a 0.09 USDC pack (fits the $0.10 x402 cap, 0.099 credit) or 5/10/20 USDC packs, all with +10% bonus, at /v1/credit?pack=0.09.
